subject: Crosswalk SDK: stability guarantees & deprecation gating
messages:
From: Alex Park <alex@cloudbridge.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Sofia Lane <sofia@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: crosswalk compatibility guarantees & deprecation window

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Crosswalk adapter is looking promising for our managed inference pipeline. We have a few partner engineering asks before we commit to the integration timeline:

- We need explicit stability guarantees for the public SDK surface for the next 12 months (method names, request/response shapes).
- If Redwood plans to deprecate or rename any client-facing endpoints, we need a minimum 90-day notice plus a compatibility shim plan.
- We also asked for a matrix showing which runtime versions will be supported by which Redwood model variants.

I attached a proposed change matrix (cloudbridge_sdk_change_matrix.xlsx) showing the fields we care about. Can you share a Redwood-owned deprecation gating checklist and a realistic timeline for any breaking changes?

Goal is to align on a go-live in Q1 2027 but we can't commit until we have those guardrails.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Partner Engineering, CloudBridge
[attachment: cloudbridge_sdk_change_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Alex Park <alex@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: crosswalk compatibility guarantees & deprecation window

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear asks and the change matrix. Short answer: we can meet the notice and shim requirements, but we want to be explicit about timelines and operational gating. High-level plan below; I'll loop in our partnerships and runtime teams to produce the formal checklist and timeline doc.

Planned approach:
1) Stability pledge: We will classify public SDK surface into two buckets — "stable" and "experimental." Stable APIs get 12 months of backward-compatibility support plus security patches.
2) Deprecation policy: Public-stable APIs will have a 90-day minimum notice for breaking changes. For changes that affect client libraries, we provide a compatibility shim for at least one major version cycle.
3) Runtime mapping: We'll create a model-to-runtime matrix for the next 6 quarters to help you plan.

Can you confirm the exact methods/objects in your matrix that you consider "stable" today? That will help scope the checklist. We'll produce a draft deprecation gating checklist and a proposed timeline by Wednesday.

Jonas Weber
Director, Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
[attachment: crosswalk_deprecation_plan_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: draft checklist and blocking items for CloudBridge

Team —

I reviewed Jonas' reply and started a draft checklist. A few technical blockers we need to decide before sending the public doc to CloudBridge:

- Canary policy: do we require partner-facing traffic to run on dedicated canaries for 2 weeks before a library deprecation? My recommendation: yes for any change touching request shapes.
- SDK distribution: we need to commit to semantic versioning and a deprecation field in the package metadata (we currently only document changes in release notes).
- Telemetry: partners want a list of runtime metrics we will expose (latency p50/p95, token consumption breakdown). We can expose these via a partner-only dashboard but need to scope retention.

I'll attach the working checklist in Drive and a redlines doc with suggested language. If no objections, I'll push the first formal draft to CloudBridge tomorrow.

- Vanessa
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference

[attachment: crosswalk_deprecation_plan_v1.pdf (application/pdf), attachment: cloudbridge_sdk_change_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Alex Park <alex@cloudbridge.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Sofia Lane <sofia@cloudbridge.io>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Crosswalk SDK: stability guarantees & deprecation gating

Thanks, Jonas and Vanessa — this looks good. A couple of clarifying asks from our engineering lead: 

- The 90-day deprecation starts from the first public announcement or from the first SDK release that no longer supports the old surface? We prefer publication date.
- For shims: can Redwood commit to maintaining the shim for at least two minor releases of our package manager (npm/pip) to make upgrades easier on our side?
- Can we get a list of the telemetry fields you'll surface in the partner dashboard (even if it's a sketch)?

If you can answer those three before EOD PT we can finalize our internal signoff and lock the Q1 2027 window.

Best,
Alex
Partner Engineering, CloudBridge

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Alex Park <alex@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Crosswalk SDK: stability guarantees & deprecation gating (final)

Alex —

Short answers inline:
- Deprecation timing: starts at public announcement (we'll publish signed changelog entries and a partner notification email).
- Shim duration: we will maintain compatibility shims for the greater of 90 days or two minor releases as published on the relevant package index (npm/pypi). We'll call this out explicitly in the deprecation notice.
- Telemetry sketch: partner dashboard will include p50/p95 latency, per-route token counts, error rates by HTTP status, and a daily-aggregate cost estimate. Full retention policy: 90 days for partner dashboard metrics (we can negotiate extended retention in Enterprise add-on).

Next steps: Vanessa will share the formal deprecation gating checklist and the runtime-model matrix by EOD tomorrow. Please confirm acceptance of the shim duration so we can update the contract addendum (I logged a HubSpot note: 987654321).

Thanks — looking forward to shipping this with CloudBridge.

Jonas Weber
Director, Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
[attachments: crosswalk_deprecation_plan_v1.pdf, cloudbridge_sdk_change_matrix.xlsx]
